observations: Single cream/beige upholstered seat shown from above/side angle, cropped
Channel-tufted or ribbed design on backrest and armrest
Surface appears to be suede or faux-leather finish, material not clearly verifiable
No legs, base, or underside visible in frame

claims.evidence: No wear timeline can be read from a single static photo; age claims cannot be confirmed remotely.
No tape measure, doorway, or other reference object in photo 0 to confirm length.

risks.risk: Hidden stains, tears, or discoloration on unseen sides/cushions
risks.proof: Full-body shots from front, back, and both side angles in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear/staining, not as near-new

risks.risk: Material may be faux leather/suede rather than genuine leather, affecting value
risks.proof: Close-up macro shot of the fabric grain/texture, plus any care tag
risks.if_unproven: priced as faux/synthetic material, the lower-value assumption

risks.risk: Actual length may be shorter than the stated 'over 4 feet'
risks.proof: Photo of the sofa with a tape measure or known-length object alongside it
risks.if_unproven: priced at the minimum plausible size for a single-seat chair, not as a full loveseat/sofa

risks.risk: Frame, springs, or legs could be damaged or missing, not visible in the single cropped photo
risks.proof: Photo of the underside and all legs, plus a short video of someone sitting on it
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming unknown structural condition, i.e. worst case

risks.risk: Listing photo is watermarked by a third-party reseller, raising doubt about whether this is the actual item in the seller's possession
risks.proof: A fresh, un-watermarked photo taken by the seller today, ideally with a handwritten date/note
risks.if_unproven: priced cautiously as a stock/recycled photo, not confirmed to be the exact unit for sale

proof_requests: Fresh, un-watermarked photos of the full sofa from front, back, and both sides
Photo with a tape measure showing actual length and seat width
Close-up of the upholstery texture and any care/brand tag
Photo of the legs and underside
Short video showing someone sitting on it to confirm structural soundness
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a sofa/loveseat by type even without a brand or model, and the single available photo is enough to price it conservatively; all seller claims about age and size remain unverifiable remote, so the item is priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
